query: SELECT t.pid AS "pid!", GREATEST(t.updated_at, (SELECT max(a.occurred_at) FROM activities a WHERE a.subject_kind = 'ticket' AND a.subject_pid = t.pid AND a.deleted_at IS NULL), (SELECT max(m.created_at) FROM ticket_movements m WHERE m.ticket_pid = t.pid)) AS "last!: crate::models::DateTimeWithTimeZone" FROM tickets t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status IN ('open', 'pending')
